753:t_207:20.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Come, $n! If you can do it, then go ahead and try!!」

753:t_207:21.en:
$n
「Beyond hope, despair, and the past, we seek the future! That is what it means to be human!!」

753:t_208:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Apostle of the $$ゲッター線$$, $$號$$... Was it you who guided the people of Earth?」

753:t_208:3.en:
$$凱$$
「We stay as one to the very end! Three hearts joined as one, charging that so-called god!」

753:t_208:4.en:
$$號$$
「Right. Living together and moving forward together is the truth of life.」

753:t_208:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Then I will teach you that there is a being beyond that.」

753:t_209:0.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「The managers of the universe, the $$御使い$$s... and Advent, who surpasses even them...」

753:t_209:1.en:
$$田中司令$$
「We've come a long way, haven't we?」

753:t_209:2.en:
$$ウラジミール$$
「We traveled to the center of the galaxy, and now we're coming back to Earth from there.」

753:t_209:3.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「But that planet is exactly what we have to protect.」

753:t_209:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Your journey of battle ends here. You will perish with the universe, and gain new life in a new world.」

753:t_209:5.en:
$$田中司令$$
「No, thank you. We're rather fond of this world.」

753:t_209:6.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「So we resist with everything we have... staking our human pride.」

753:t_209:7.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「$$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$, charge! With our strength, we'll clear the mist that shrouds this universe's future!!」

753:t_210:0.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All guns, target! We settle every battle here and now!」

753:t_210:1.en:
$$メラン$$
「All stations functioning normally! We can go anytime!」

753:t_210:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「To resist to the last moment without abandoning hope... As expected of a ship captained by the man who has supported the civilization of fire.」

753:t_210:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I will repay your fighting, which could be called the model of a soldier.」

753:t_210:4.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Don't listen to the enemy's provocation! What's demanded of us is results, not process!」

753:t_210:5.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We win, no matter what! All hands, don't forget that people's future depends on our actions!!」

753:t_211:0.en:
$$オットー$$
「All hands, rouse yourselves! This is the final battle!」

753:t_211:2.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
「No problems! Everyone is at their posts!」

753:t_211:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Coming at me out of a sense of duty... Ignorance is a terrifying thing.」

753:t_211:4.en:
$$オットー$$
「What's wrong with soldiers carrying out their duty!? We will carry out our mission with everything we have, for the citizens!」

753:t_211:5.en:
$$オットー$$
「But let me add one more thing! On behalf of the entire universe, this ship is going to hit that smug, infuriating grin of yours with one hell of a punch!」

753:t_211:7.en:
$$オットー$$
「All hands, let's do this! We'll show that phony god our true strength!!」

753:t_212:0.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Our opponent calls himself a god...! Whatever his nature, we can't help but acknowledge his power...!」

753:t_212:1.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「After picking a fight with the whole world, you think we'd flinch now!?」

753:t_212:2.en:
$$フェルト$$
「I made up my mind long ago!」

753:t_212:3.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「No matter who the enemy is, $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ is $$ソレスタルビーイング$$!」

753:t_212:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You followed $$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$'s plan all the way here, and today you are relieved of your mission.」

753:t_212:5.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$イオリア$$'s plan doesn't matter anymore! We're taking part in this battle of our own free will!」

753:t_212:6.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「And we will protect them! Everyone who believes in this world's future, together with our comrades!」

753:t_212:7.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Begin the attack, everyone! Final mission, start!!」

753:t_213:0.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「This is the critical moment, you rascals! Pour every last bit of power we have left into it!!」

753:t_213:1.en:
$$ボビー$$
「The $$ボス$$ is really fired up!」

753:t_213:4.en:
$$ミーナ#pt251$$
「A battle that decides the fate of the universe...!」

753:t_213:5.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Let's all fight as one, every member of the $$マクロス・クォーター$$ staff!」

753:t_213:6.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「The ship and its entire crew undergo $$真化融合$$...!」

753:t_213:7.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「That is the bond of us... of the $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$!」

753:t_213:8.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Macross is the name of a ship that carves out an infinite future! We'll show you its power, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!!」

753:t_214:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I did a pitiful thing to $$レナード$$.」

753:t_214:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「So, $$テッサ$$... I will carry you to the new world in his place. There, you can build your ideal family.」

753:t_214:3.en:
$$テッサ$$
「So you too ignore the sacrifices made along the way, as long as the result is good.」

753:t_214:4.en:
$$テッサ$$
「What a shoddy dictator for someone who calls himself a god! In the end, only the scale is big. Your ego is no different from any petty mortal's!」

753:t_214:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「How unpleasant. I am a being who has surpassed even the $$御使い$$s.」

753:t_214:6.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Then I'll ruin your entire plan! By defeating you yourself!」

753:t_214:7.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Preparations for the attack are already complete.」

753:t_214:8.en:
$$テッサ$$
「To all hands! With courage and pride, we will strike down this great evil and protect the world and the universe!」

753:t_214:10.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, commence attack! Show this god who doesn't know his place who rules the sea of space!」

753:t_215:0.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「Let's do this, everyone! $$超銀河ダイグレン$$, charge!」

753:t_215:1.en:
$$リーロン$$
「We're ready whenever you are!」

753:t_215:3.en:
$$テツカン$$
「We've got our pride too!」

753:t_215:5.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「The long-cherished wish of every life living in this galaxy will finally be fulfilled...!」

753:t_215:6.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「They come at me even knowing it's futile... Their recklessness is almost endearing.」

753:t_215:7.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「Futile, my ass! This blow will definitely damage you!」

753:t_215:8.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「$$キヨウ$$, $$アンネ$$! I'll protect your future and the future of the universe!!」

753:t_216:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Magnificent, $$トライア$$. And you too, $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$.」

753:t_216:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I will permit you to offer that ship and the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ to $$至高神Ｚ$$.」

753:t_216:2.en:
$$トライア$$
「Don't underestimate the crystallization of Earth's wisdom. Give it a little more time, and it'll become something that can even rival your $$黒い太陽#sol$$.」

753:t_216:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If you think you can make everything yours, you're dead wrong!」

753:t_216:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「A devil lecturing a god. How absurd, $$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$.」

753:t_216:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That composed attitude of yours really ticks me off!」

753:t_216:6.en:
$$トライア$$
「You're not the only one he ticks off.」

753:t_216:7.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「One who blocks humanity's future...!」

753:t_216:8.en:
$$トビー$$
「One who accepts the universe's collapse...!」

753:t_216:9.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「A false god who takes lives for his ego...!」

753:t_216:10.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「An enemy who robs us of freedom and peace with his self-righteousness...!」
